GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   B. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   B. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   C. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   D. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   B. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   D. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

11. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   B. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Trade as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Plan income and spending wisely

3. C — Nairobi

4. D — Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Obeying laws and caring for public property

11. B — Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Action of wind and water in arid areas; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
